# Bibek Kumar Yadav (Bibek Yadav)

> Bibek Kumar Yadav, also known as Bibek Yadav, is a Full Stack Developer (ASP.NET Core & WordPress) based in Kathmandu, Nepal. He works as a Web Developer at Shiva Tatwa Digital and is a BSc (Hons) Computer Systems Engineering (BSc IT) student at ISMT College, Kathmandu, affiliated with the University of Sunderland, UK.

- Official website and portfolio: https://bibek-yadav.com.np/

- Location: Kathmandu, Nepal
- Languages: English, Nepali, Maithili, Hindi

## Education

- BSc (Hons) Computer Systems Engineering (BSc IT), ISMT College, Kathmandu (affiliated with the University of Sunderland, UK), August 2025 to present
- +2 Management (Business Studies & Economics), Khwopa Secondary School, Bhaktapur, 2023 to 2025
- SEE (Secondary Education Examination), Nabin English School, 2023

## Work experience

- Web Developer at Shiva Tatwa Digital, Budhanilkantha, Kathmandu (August 2026 to present). Designed, built and launched 5 live client websites on custom WordPress themes, and manages hosting on cPanel (domains, DNS, site migrations).

## Skills

- Backend: C#, ASP.NET Core MVC, Entity Framework Core, PHP
- Frontend: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, Bootstrap, responsive design
- Databases: SQL Server, MySQL
- CMS: WordPress custom themes and custom post types
- Hosting and cloud: Microsoft Azure, cPanel, domains and DNS, Vercel, Cloudflare Pages
- Tools: Git, GitHub, Visual Studio, VS Code, Python (basic)
